question: Clutch time means the last 5 minutes of the 4th quarter or any overtime, when the score is within 5 points. Is free-throw shooting any different in clutch time than the rest of the game, league-wide, from 2015-16 to 2022-23?
answer:
While a simple comparison of raw league averages makes it look like free-throw shooting improves slightly in late-game situations, this is an illusion of selection bias. When controlling for who is actually taking the shots, **NBA players shoot 1.27 percentage points worse on clutch free throws** than their baseline averages during the rest of the game. 

*Clutch time is defined as the 4th quarter or overtime, with 5:00 or less remaining, and the score within 5 points going into the play.*

### League-Wide Free Throw Shooting (2015-16 to 2022-23)

| Split | Free Throw Attempts (FTA) | Free Throws Made (FTM) | FT% | Expected FT%¹ | Difference |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Non-Clutch Time (Baseline)** | 394,142 | 303,917 | 77.11% | — | — |
| **Clutch Time (Raw)** | 27,427 | 21,255 | 77.50% | 78.77% | **-1.27%** |

*¹ **Expected FT%** represents what we would expect the clutch free-throw percentage to be if every player shot exactly their own non-clutch baseline average on those same attempts.*

---

### High-Volume Individual Players in Clutch Time
Because the league-wide drop-off is driven by a broad trend, it is helpful to look at how the league's most frequent late-game free-throw shooters perform in these moments:

| Player | Clutch FTA | Clutch FT% | Baseline FTA | Baseline FT% | Difference |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Stephen Curry** | 233 | 92.7% | 2,401 | 90.8% | +1.9% |
| **Kyrie Irving** | 247 | 90.3% | 1,645 | 90.3% | 0.0% |
| **Damian Lillard** | 352 | 90.3% | 3,452 | 90.5% | -0.2% |
| **Kevin Durant** | 243 | 86.4% | 3,032 | 89.7% | -3.3% |
| **James Harden** | 487 | 83.4% | 5,052 | 86.6% | -3.2% |
| **DeMar DeRozan** | 417 | 83.0% | 3,719 | 85.3% | -2.3% |
| **Joel Embiid** | 358 | 82.7% | 3,693 | 81.8% | +0.9% |
| **Russell Westbrook** | 313 | 78.6% | 3,543 | 74.2% | +4.4% |
| **Giannis Antetokounmpo** | 286 | 69.2% | 5,089 | 69.8% | -0.5% |
| **LeBron James** | 331 | 68.6% | 3,311 | 71.8% | -3.2% |

---

### Key Caveats & Statistical Context

* **The Survivor Effect (Selection Bias):** The raw clutch FT% (77.50%) is higher than the non-clutch average (77.11%) only because coaches put the ball in the hands of their best shooters at the end of games. High-percentage free-throw shooters take a disproportionate share of late-game free throws, artificially raising the unadjusted average.
* **Individual Noise vs. League-Wide Signal:** Across a league-wide sample of 27,427 clutch free throws, the standard error is extremely small (~0.25%), making the -1.27% drop highly robust. However, for an individual player with 250 clutch attempts, the standard error is roughly 2.5%. This means individual differences (such as LeBron James's -3.2% drop or Stephen Curry's +1.9% rise) are well within the margin of normal statistical noise. We should be very careful about labeling individuals as "clutch" or "chokers" based on these samples.
* **Data Limits:** This analysis spans from the 2015-16 season through the 2022-23 season (regular season and playoffs). Roughly 9% of total games during this span do not have play-by-play data available in the dataset and are omitted, though this does not bias the overall findings.

# Schema (DuckDB views; query these, never raw files)

All tables below are read-only views. Prefer `plays`, `games`, `game_swings`, `player_shooting`, `team_game_clutch`.


## plays
MAIN TABLE. One row per play-by-play event with parsed clock, running score, decoded event type, shot details and is_clutch.

| column | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| game_id | VARCHAR |  |
| eventnum | BIGINT | order key within a game (a few late-added rows are out of order; sort by period, secs_left_period DESC, eventnum) |
| game_date | DATE |  |
| season_start_year | INTEGER |  |
| season_label | VARCHAR |  |
| season_type | VARCHAR |  |
| home_team | VARCHAR |  |
| away_team | VARCHAR |  |
| period | BIGINT | 1-4 = quarters, 5+ = overtimes |
| secs_left_period | INTEGER | seconds left in the period (quarters 720 long, OT 300 long) |
| secs_left_game | BIGINT | seconds left in regulation (period<=4); in OT it is seconds left in that OT period |
| home_score | INTEGER | home points AFTER this event |
| away_score | INTEGER | away points AFTER this event |
| home_margin | INTEGER | home_score - away_score AFTER this event (positive = home leading) |
| home_margin_before | INTEGER | margin going INTO this event |
| event_type | VARCHAR | decoded event, see glossary |
| eventmsgtype | BIGINT |  |
| eventmsgactiontype | BIGINT |  |
| acting_side | VARCHAR | 'HOME'/'AWAY' = team of the player who did the event (NULL for period start/end, replay) |
| acting_team | VARCHAR | team abbreviation of acting_side |
| player_id | VARCHAR | main player of the event (shooter, rebounder, turnover committer, fouler) |
| player_name | VARCHAR | e.g. 'Stephen Curry' (full name); NULL for team events like team rebounds |
| player2_id | VARCHAR |  |
| player2_name | VARCHAR | assister (made shot), fouled player (foul), stealer (turnover) |
| player3_id | VARCHAR |  |
| player3_name | VARCHAR | blocker (missed shot) |
| description | VARCHAR | raw play text from the feed |
| is_three | BOOLEAN | TRUE for 3-point attempts (made or missed); NULL for non-shot events |
| points_scored | INTEGER | points from this event parsed from text (see limits: not exact in ~4% of games) |
| shot_kind | VARCHAR | three_pointer | two_point_jumper | layup | dunk | hook | tip_in | other (shots only) |
| shot_distance_ft | INTEGER | feet from basket parsed from text; NULL for many dunks/tips |
| is_clutch | BOOLEAN | TRUE when period>=4, <=300 secs left in the period, and |home_margin_before|<=5 |

## clutch_plays
plays filtered to is_clutch = TRUE (same columns as plays).


## games
One row per game (note: ~9% of games here have no play-by-play; use plays/game_swings for anything event-based).

| column | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| game_id | VARCHAR |  |
| game_date | DATE |  |
| season_start_year | INTEGER | 2022 = the 2022-23 season |
| season_label | VARCHAR | e.g. '2022-23' |
| season_type | VARCHAR | 'Regular Season' or 'Playoffs' |
| home_team_id | VARCHAR |  |
| home_team | VARCHAR |  |
| away_team_id | VARCHAR |  |
| away_team | VARCHAR |  |
| pts_home | INTEGER |  |
| pts_away | INTEGER |  |
| home_won | BOOLEAN | TRUE if home team won |
| winner | VARCHAR | winning team abbreviation |
| loser | VARCHAR | losing team abbreviation |

## game_swings
One row per game (with play-by-play): largest leads/deficits, comeback flags, lead changes.

| column | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| game_id | VARCHAR |  |
| game_date | DATE |  |
| season_start_year | INTEGER |  |
| season_label | VARCHAR |  |
| season_type | VARCHAR |  |
| home_team | VARCHAR |  |
| away_team | VARCHAR |  |
| pts_home | INTEGER |  |
| pts_away | INTEGER |  |
| winner | VARCHAR |  |
| loser | VARCHAR |  |
| home_max_lead | INTEGER | home team's biggest lead |
| away_max_lead | INTEGER | away team's biggest lead |
| winner_max_deficit | INTEGER | biggest deficit the eventual winner faced = biggest lead the loser blew |
| comeback_10 | BOOLEAN | winner trailed by 10+ at some point (15/20 similar) |
| comeback_15 | BOOLEAN |  |
| comeback_20 | BOOLEAN |  |
| lead_changes | BIGINT | from other_stats (official count) |
| times_tied | BIGINT | from other_stats |

## player_shooting
Per player x season x season_type x is_clutch: FGA/FGM/3PA/3PM/FTA/FTM/pts from play-by-play.

| column | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| player_id | VARCHAR |  |
| player_name | VARCHAR |  |
| season_start_year | INTEGER |  |
| season_label | VARCHAR |  |
| season_type | VARCHAR |  |
| is_clutch | BOOLEAN | TRUE row = clutch plays only; FALSE row = all other plays |
| games | BIGINT | distinct games in which the player had at least one shot/FT in this split |
| fga | BIGINT |  |
| fgm | BIGINT |  |
| fg3a | BIGINT |  |
| fg3m | BIGINT |  |
| fta | BIGINT |  |
| ftm | BIGINT |  |
| pts | HUGEINT | sum of points_scored (approximate, see limits) |

## team_game_clutch
Per team x game: points for/against during clutch plays (only games with at least one clutch play).

| column | type | notes |
|---|---|---|
| game_id | VARCHAR |  |
| season_start_year | INTEGER |  |
| season_label | VARCHAR |  |
| season_type | VARCHAR |  |
| team | VARCHAR |  |
| opponent | VARCHAR |  |
| is_home | BOOLEAN | TRUE if team was the home team |
| clutch_pts_for | HUGEINT | points the team scored on clutch plays |
| clutch_pts_against | HUGEINT | points the opponent scored on clutch plays |

## other_stats
Official box extras per game: team_id/abbr home & away, pts_paint, pts_fb (fast break), pts_2nd_chance, largest_lead, lead_changes, times_tied, turnovers (total_turnovers_*, team_turnovers_*), team_rebounds, pts_off_to (points off turnovers).

| column | type | notes |

| game_id | VARCHAR |  |

| team_id_home | VARCHAR |  |
| team_abbreviation_home | VARCHAR |  |

| pts_paint_home | BIGINT |  |
| pts_2nd_chance_home | BIGINT |  |
| pts_fb_home | BIGINT |  |

| lead_changes | BIGINT |  |

## line_score
Points by quarter and OT per game: pts_qtr1_home .. pts_qtr4_home, pts_ot1_home.., same for _away.

args.query:
SELECT is_clutch, SUM(fta) AS fta, SUM(ftm) AS ftm, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ftm) / SUM(fta), 2) AS ft_pct
FROM player_shooting
GROUP BY is_clutch ORDER BY is_clutch

SELECT season_label, season_type,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fta,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_ftm,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END), 2) AS clutch_ft_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS other_fta,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS other_ftm,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END), 2) AS other_ft_pct,
       ROUND((100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END)) - 
             (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS diff
FROM player_shooting
GROUP BY season_label, season_type
ORDER BY season_label, season_type

SELECT season_type,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fta,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_ftm,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END), 2) AS clutch_ft_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS other_fta,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS other_ftm,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END), 2) AS other_ft_pct,
       ROUND((100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END)) - 
             (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END)), 2) AS diff
FROM player_shooting
GROUP BY season_type
ORDER BY season_type

WITH player_ft AS (
    SELECT player_id, player_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fta,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_ftm,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS other_fta,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS other_ftm
    FROM player_shooting
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_players,
       SUM(clutch_fta) AS tot_clutch_fta,
       SUM(clutch_ftm) AS tot_clutch_ftm,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(clutch_ftm) / SUM(clutch_fta), 2) AS overall_clutch_pct,
       -- Let's look at average of individual player differences for players with min 50 clutch FTA
       ROUND(AVG((100.0 * clutch_ftm / clutch_fta) - (100.0 * other_ftm / other_fta)), 2) AS avg_player_diff_pct
FROM player_ft
WHERE clutch_fta >= 50 AND other_fta >= 100

WITH player_ft AS (
    SELECT player_id, player_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fta,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_ftm,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS other_fta,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS other_ftm
    FROM player_shooting
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name
),
valid_players AS (
    SELECT *,
           (100.0 * other_ftm / NULLIF(other_fta, 0)) AS baseline_ft_pct
    FROM player_ft
)
SELECT 
    SUM(clutch_fta) AS total_clutch_fta,
    SUM(clutch_ftm) AS total_clutch_ftm,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(clutch_ftm) / SUM(clutch_fta), 2) AS actual_clutch_pct,
    -- Expected clutch FTM if everyone shot their exact baseline
    ROUND(SUM(clutch_fta * (other_ftm::DOUBLE / NULLIF(other_fta, 0))) / SUM(clutch_fta) * 100, 2) AS expected_clutch_pct
FROM valid_players
WHERE clutch_fta > 0 AND other_fta > 0

WITH player_ft AS (
    SELECT player_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fta,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_ftm,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fta ELSE 0 END) AS other_fta,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN ftm ELSE 0 END) AS other_ftm
    FROM player_shooting
    GROUP BY player_name
)
SELECT player_name,
       clutch_fta,
       ROUND(100.0 * clutch_ftm / clutch_fta, 1) AS clutch_ft_pct,
       other_fta,
       ROUND(100.0 * other_ftm / other_fta, 1) AS other_ft_pct,
       ROUND((100.0 * clutch_ftm / clutch_fta) - (100.0 * other_ftm / other_fta), 1) AS diff
FROM player_ft
WHERE clutch_fta >= 150
ORDER BY clutch_fta DESC
